items.reason: Gap 1 describes a duplicate delivery processed concurrently by queue workers, both missing the Set before either adds the id, so the event is processed twice.
Gap 2 says the signature covers only the body while deduplication keys on the X-Event-Id header, so a modified header on a validly signed body bypasses deduplication.
Gap 0 says refunds arrive as charge.refunded and miss the handler registered as refund.created, so refunds are never recorded.
No gap depends on several processes or replicas; the concurrency raised is among queue workers within one process.
